units.difficulty_basis: Apply a single horizontal translation to a supplied point.
units.summary: Map a point under a horizontal translation.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Interchange a supplied point’s coordinates for an inverse function.
units.summary: Map a point to an inverse-function graph.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Combine a modulus reflection, vertical stretch and translation in the correct order.
units.summary: Map a point under a modulus transformation.

units.difficulty_basis: Read the circle centre and simplify the square root of its squared radius.
units.summary: Find a circle’s centre and simplified radius.

units.difficulty_basis: Compare the origin’s centre distance with the radius using the supplied circle equation.
units.summary: Determine whether the origin lies inside a circle.

exceptions: Raw(a)(ii) is the joint centre/radius tariff for(a)(i)–(ii).

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Equate consecutive arithmetic differences to determine a parameter, then reuse it in a finite-sum formula.
units.summary: Determine an arithmetic sequence and its finite sum.

units.difficulty_basis: Use the known root in polynomial division and show the remaining quadratic has no real roots.
units.summary: Factor a cubic and prove it has only one real root.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Recognise a limiting sum as a definite integral and evaluate its reciprocal-square-root integrand exactly.
units.summary: Evaluate a limiting sum using a definite integral.

units.difficulty_basis: Fit two constants from supplied heights and rational powers, then use the fitted curve to interpret initial height and the physical endpoint.
units.summary: Fit and interpret a power-function bird-height model.

units.difficulty_basis: Read increasing sections and stationary endpoints directly from the supplied quartic graph.
units.summary: Determine where a graph has nonnegative gradient.

units.difficulty_basis: Infer repeated factors from tangent roots and a scale from the intercept, then use the minimum height to constrain a vertical translation.
units.summary: Construct a quartic and constrain a vertical translation.

units.difficulty_basis: Correct an expansion error and complete the exhaustive residue-class cases needed for an integer-square proof.
units.summary: Correct and complete a proof by exhaustion.

units.difficulty_basis: Set the supplied speed model to zero and solve the positive exponential stopping-time equation.
units.summary: Find a modelled car stopping time.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Differentiate a product involving an exponential, impose a stationary-speed condition and rearrange logarithmically.
units.summary: Derive a maximum-speed equation.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Apply the explicitly supplied iteration and continue until the time is stable to the requested precision.
units.summary: Iterate to estimate a maximum-speed time.

exceptions: Raw(c)(ii) is the joint tariff for the third iterate and the converged time.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Add three-dimensional displacements, calculate side magnitudes and use equality and Pythagoras to prove triangle properties.
units.summary: Prove a vector triangle is right-angled and isosceles.

units.difficulty_basis: Fit the initial value and decay constant using a supplied later value and logarithms.
units.summary: Fit an exponential car-value model.

units.difficulty_basis: Use the exponential-gradient rule and replace the exponential term with the supplied expression for value.
units.summary: Express an exponential depreciation rate in terms of value.

units.difficulty_basis: Identify a limitation of the stated long-term depreciation assumptions.
units.summary: Critique a car-value decay model.

units.difficulty_basis: Verify one intersection, clear rational denominators, factor the resulting cubic and select the other valid exact root.
units.summary: Find exact intersections of a rational curve and line.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Choose a linear substitution or equivalent algebraic rewriting and evaluate a rational definite integral exactly.
units.summary: Evaluate a rational definite integral by substitution.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Expand compound angles to prove the supplied identity and reuse it with a double-angle expression to retain all interval roots.
units.summary: Prove a compound-angle identity and solve a trig equation.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Eliminate a sector angle using the fixed area, construct the perimeter function and differentiate twice to establish a minimum.
units.summary: Minimise the perimeter of a sector-and-rectangle stage.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Transform a square-root integrand and both limits using the specified trigonometric substitution, then integrate a reciprocal-trig form exactly.
units.summary: Evaluate a trig-substitution area with a square-root denominator.
